title: In-app help and how-to panel
summary: Add a slide-out help panel with contextual how-to guides for every web UI area, plus a story, tasks and evals.
rationale: No requirement covers in-app help; product owner asked for a detailed help and how-to section delivered as a slide-out panel. Guide topics and Markdown-in-repo content source use the recommended defaults pending confirmation.

data.title: In-app help and how-to panel
data.statement: The system shall provide a slide-out help panel, openable from every web UI view, containing step-by-step how-to guides for each area of the web UI.
data.rationale: Product owners and new users need guidance on reqforge workflows without leaving the UI.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Help button in the header opens the panel over the current view in 1 click, without changing the route, filters or selection
The panel opens on the section matching the active tab and offers a table of contents linking to every section
The panel contains numbered how-to guides for at least 6 topics: browse and filter, edit and bulk update, chat and changesets, lint and traceability, verification evidence and impact, and projects
A search box in the panel filters sections by keyword and shows a no-results message when nothing matches
Help content is authored as Markdown files versioned in the repository and bundled with the web UI
The panel is keyboard operable: focus moves into it on open, Esc closes it, and focus returns to the Help button

data.title: In-app help and how-to panel
data.narrative: As a product owner new to reqforge, I want a help panel with how-to guides I can open from any view so that I can learn each workflow without leaving my work.
